messages:
oncall-bot: pagerduty alert: increased 5xx rate on /v1/generate (svc=inference, metric=5xx_rate) — paging on-call
Alex K: getting the page now, looking at prod dashboards. 5xx spike visible across regions.
Nora S: I'm oncall — standing up. quick first question: any obvious recent deploys?
Jordan P: no deploys in the last 40m from deploy-bot, infra looks quiet.
Maya R: seeing customer reports of timeouts and some 502s, SLO error budget getting hit for a few orgs.
Liam H: can you link the alert dashboard?
Alex K: https://dash.internal/redwood/inference/5xx-rate — main chart shows jump at ~09:07 UTC.
Nora S: reassigning to @Maya for initial triage, I will start a timeline here and grab request ids.
Maya R: taking triage. first hypothesis: upstream model-serving timeouts or network flaps to the kv-cache.
Jordan P: running ad-hoc log query for errors with request_id, sampling might be low though. query: `service:inference AND status>=500 | sort @timestamp desc | limit 200`
Alex K: logs in sum show `context deadline exceeded` and `kv_cache: timeout` in many entries.
Maya R: hmm, we have a config push earlier today that changed trace/log sampling from 10% -> 1% (ops-change: sampling-reduction). that could affect our ability to reconstruct timelines.
Nora S: that's bad timing. anyone know who pushed that change?
Liam H: ops-change was rolled by infra-team (Jordan), approved by SRE. Jordan, can you confirm?
Jordan P: yep, I rolled a global sampling update 08:58 UTC to reduce costs. I also updated logging-agent on hosts. No expected behavioral change, but I didn't think it would affect 5xx visibility.
Maya R: if sampling dropped we may be missing correlated logs that show the root cause. can we temporarily flip sampling back to 10% for the inference cluster?
Alex K: I can push a rollback to sampling=10% for the inference pool. will coordinate with SRE for safety.
ora s: typo — Nora here, please note: we should also turn on verbose error logging for gateway for next 15m, then revert.
Jordan P: starting rollback now. `kubectl set env ds/log-agent SAMPLING_PERCENT=10 -n inference` (will monitor).
(oncall-bot): deploybot: rollout started for log-agent sampling update (change id changelog-9821)
Maya R: while that's happening, we need to collect request_ids for impacted customers. Alex, can you extract top 20 failing request_ids from the last 30m and paste here?
Alex K: pulling now. query results (truncated):
```
request_id: a1f3c2e7 status: 502 error="kv cache timeout"
request_id: b7d4ff12 status: 504 error="upstream timeout"
request_id: c9a1a333 status: 502 error="context deadline exceeded"
... (20 total)
```
Maya R: good. forwarding to support to contact impacted customers. Jordan, any errors from infra side?
Jordan P: infra logs show intermittent TCP retries to redis cluster at ~09:05-09:10 UTC. network telemetry shows brief congestion spike in us-west-2 in the infra vpc (packet drops ~0.8%).
Liam H: can we confirm fallbacks? Are requests retried or do they surface 502s to users?
Alex K: gateway config is currently not retrying on kv-cache timeout for low-latency calls — it returns 502 immediately.
Nora S: mitigation plan: 1) rollback sampling to 10% (in progress), 2) enable short retry (1 retry, 200ms) at gateway for kv-cache timeouts, 3) open support ticket batch for impacted orgs, 4) build timeline for RCA.
Maya R: adding step 5) investigate why sampling change coincided with network degradation — could be correlation not causation, but we need logs fixed first.
Jordan P: sampling rollback completed at 09:18 UTC. logs ingress rate jumped ~6x after rollback; we now have more traces.
sre-bot: observation: log volume increase detected, adjust retention to avoid quota.
Alex K: enabling gateway retry rule now. `PATCH /api/gateway/config` body: `{ "retry_on_kv_timeout": { "retries":1, "backoff_ms":200 } }`
(oncall-bot): configbot: gateway config patch applied (cfg-id cfg-2026)
Maya R: monitoring error rate after fixes. 5xx rate dropped back to baseline by 09:27 UTC.
Liam H: customer impact assessment: about 12 orgs had elevated errors for ~20 minutes. ticket created INC-7432-CUST with list of request_ids.
Nora S: handing off to Jordan for deeper post-incident analysis. Jordan, please capture timeline and hypotheses in this thread for the RCA.
Jordan P: will do. initial timeline draft:
- 08:58 UTC: sampling reduced 10% -> 1% (ops-change)
- 09:05 UTC: network telemetry shows congestion spike in us-west-2 (packet drops increase)
- 09:07 UTC: 5xx spike visible on dashboards, first pager
- 09:12 UTC: mitigation rollback of sampling started
- 09:18 UTC: sampling rollback complete, logs restored
- 09:19 UTC: gateway retry rule applied
- 09:27 UTC: 5xx rate back to baseline
Jordan P: hypotheses list:
1) Primary: network congestion to redis + low sampling reduced our ability to detect and correlate repeated timeouts, causing delayed mitigation.
2) Secondary: the sampling change might have altered load profiles on logging agents (burst behavior) causing transient backpressure on logging pipeline around the same time.
3) Less likely: a buggy logging-agent release coincidentally caused pipeline stalls.
Maya R: need concrete evidence for each hypothesis. Jordan, please attach relevant raw logs and pcap snippets where available. note: because of sampling we are missing some request traces between 09:00-09:12 — gap noted.
Alex K: uploading gzipped logs to slack-uploads (link): https://files.internal/incident/1805123456/logs.gz
Nora S: Observability gap action items (for RCA):
- list missing fields/events due to sampling and approximate the percentage of lost traces
- restore queries/dashboards that used sampled fields (document queries we ran)
- add guardrails: don't change global sampling without advisory ticket and canary window for heavy-latency services
- add a dashboard annotation showing when sampling changed and when rollback happened
Liam H: will own the advisory ticket and a follow-up runbook change.
Maya R: support update: sent customer notices at 09:45 UTC, included affected request_ids and timeline.
Jordan P: attaching raw net telemetry snippets and redis slowlog concat (links): https://files.internal/incident/1805123456/net.tgz, https://files.internal/incident/1805123456/redis_slow.log
Nora S: handoff summary for next oncall (Maya -> Jordan): incident mitigated, monitoring stable, RCA in progress. Jordan to continue deep dive.
(oncall-bot): handoff: oncall change scheduled — next: Jordan P (until 16:00 UTC).
Jordan P: next steps for RCA thread: correlate redis slowlog timestamps with request_ids, quantify how many retries would have prevented customer-visible errors, and propose runbook changes to avoid sampling and network issues colliding.
Maya R: note for postmortem: include exact queries used for ad-hoc analysis and a copy of the dashboard correction PR.
Alex K: quick FYI — added dashboard annotation at 09:18 UTC referencing changelog-9821 and cfg-2026.
Nora S: closing the live incident channel. moving conversation to #postmortems/inc-7432 for formal RCA writeup. leave this thread for raw timeline and artifacts. :white_check_mark:
Jordan P: ack, will post initial RCA draft in #postmortems/inc-7432 by EOD with artifacts and timeline.
Maya R: thanks everyone. short retro: avoid changing sampling on critical services without a canary window and make sure gateway retry behavior is well-documented.
Alex K: +1 — good job getting logs back quickly once rollback was done.
(oncall-bot): incident closed: INC-7432 resolved (duration ~30m)
